parts.name: ToolbarRoot
parts.description: One Tab stop: the arrow keys along `orientation` move between items, and the item last focused is where Tab comes back to.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every item. Buttons and inputs stay focusable unless they set `focusableWhenDisabled={false}`.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether the arrow keys wrap around at the ends.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

parts.name: ToolbarLink
parts.description: A link can't be disabled; it is an item like the others.

parts.name: ToolbarInput
parts.description: In the input the arrow keys move the caret; they move to the next item only from the end of the text (or the start, going back). Home and End stay with the input.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

parts.name: ToolbarGroup
parts.description: Groups items for assistive technology; `disabled` disables the items in it.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

parts.name: ToolbarSeparator
parts.description: A separator across the toolbar: vertical in a horizontal toolbar, unless `orientation` says otherwise.
